visual_mismatch_ledger.observation: The U opening is now structurally present, but the front remains a flat polygonal plate and lacks the reference's rounded plastic rollover and display region.
The feet/opening hierarchy is present but corner transitions are angular and the shell has not yet earned any surface modifier.
The cage reads as a planar tapered slab; it fails to describe the A-frame's folded continuous side/rear support and depth transition.
The continuous one-piece intent is visible, but the broad caps and simple loft reveal an inadequate 3D quad layout rather than the reference's manufactured shell.

what_was_retained: A general front-to-rear profile loft creates one connected, manifold shell and is preferable to primitive assembly for a changing outer silhouette.
An integrated concave U profile can establish the foot opening without separate feet objects.
A front/rear loft alone cannot replace the transverse edge-loop layout required to control the side-fold and rounded plastic rollover of this target.
required_next_rebuild: Add a generic quad-cage construction path that supports deliberate transverse loops and a U opening in the same continuous shell. Rebuild from that topology before display, bevel, crease, SubD, material, or high/low work.
disposition_boundary: This is rejected primary-cage evidence, not a visual pass, production asset, or proof of improved reference-modeling capability.
